meta.title: Last Stop, No Stop
meta.logline: Four strangers on a night train stalled in a snowbound valley realize one of them stole a locked case, and the train will not move until it is returned.

world.place: A single sleeper car of an overnight train, stopped in a snowbound mountain valley
rules: No phone signal and no way off the train until dawn.
The conductor speaks only over the intercom and is never seen.

style.visual_prompt: Cinematic, 35mm film grain, muted teal and amber palette, cramped train interior
style.camera: Tight medium shots, shallow depth of field, occasional low angle
style.lighting: Flickering warm cabin lights against cold blue snow outside the windows
style.motion: Slow push-ins, subtle handheld sway from the train rocking, snow drifting past windows
style.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logos, extra limbs, cartoon, daylight, morphing faces

characters.name: Mara Voss
characters.want: Reach the city by morning for her sister's custody hearing
characters.secret: She saw who carried the case aboard and has said nothing

voice.speech_style: Direct, dry humor, short sentences, deflects with questions

characters.portrait_prompt: Woman in her 30s, dark wool coat, tired sharp eyes, hair tied back

characters.name: Theo Lark
characters.want: Keep everyone calm so nobody searches his bag
characters.secret: He is carrying cash he cannot explain, unrelated to the case

voice.speech_style: Charming, talks too much when nervous, lots of jokes

characters.portrait_prompt: Young man, rumpled suit, loosened tie, easy grin that does not reach his eyes

characters.name: Ines Okafor
characters.want: Get the case back to its owner, who she claims is her employer
characters.secret: She was hired to steal the case and lost it

voice.speech_style: Precise, formal, never raises her voice

characters.portrait_prompt: Woman in her 40s, tailored grey coat, leather gloves, composed expression

characters.name: Mr. Pell
characters.want: Leave the train with the case before dawn
characters.secret: He has the case hidden in the luggage rack under a false bottom

voice.speech_style: Soft, polite, old-fashioned phrasing, long pauses

characters.portrait_prompt: Older man, neat white beard, round glasses, cardigan, reading a paperback

opening.narration: The train shudders to a stop in the dark. Snow presses against the windows. Then the intercom crackles.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Attention, sleeper car. A locked case was taken from the guard's van. This train does not move until it is returned.

lines.speaker: theo
lines.text: Well. That's a great way to wake up.

lines.speaker: ines
lines.text: Nobody leaves this car until we find it.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: Perhaps we might all sit down and be civil about this.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Or perhaps one of us should start talking.

shots.frame: Exterior: a lone night train stopped in a snowbound valley, windows glowing
shots.motion: Slow aerial drift toward the train as snow falls
shots.sound: Wind, train brakes hissing, intercom crackle

line.speaker: narrator
line.text: This train does not move until the case is returned.

shots.frame: Four strangers in a narrow sleeper car corridor under an intercom speaker
shots.motion: Slow push-in as they turn to look at each other
shots.sound: Cabin hum, snow ticking on glass

line.speaker: mara
line.text: Or perhaps one of us should start talking.

beats.purpose: Establish suspicion; everyone has a reason to look guilty
beats.must_hit: Each character gives an alibi, and one alibi has an obvious hole

shots.frame: Four strangers seated facing each other in a cramped compartment
shots.motion: Camera pans slowly from face to face, each glancing away
shots.sound: Low cabin hum, someone tapping a foot

line.speaker: theo
line.text: I was asleep. Ask anyone. Well, ask nobody, they were asleep too.

beats.must_hit: Theo's bag is opened and the unexplained cash is found

shots.frame: Theo's open duffel bag on a bunk, bundles of cash inside
shots.motion: Bag tips, cash spills onto the floor, Theo freezes
shots.sound: Zipper, paper bundles hitting the floor

line.speaker: theo
line.text: That is not what it looks like.

beats.must_hit: Mara admits she saw who carried the case aboard, but not who took it after

shots.frame: Mara standing alone by a frosted window, the others behind her
shots.motion: Slow push-in on Mara as she turns to face them

line.speaker: mara
line.text: I saw who carried that case aboard.

beats.must_hit: The case is found in the luggage rack and two people claim it

shots.frame: A suitcase pulled from the luggage rack, false bottom open, a locked case inside
shots.motion: Two pairs of hands reach for the case at once

line.speaker: pell
line.text: I believe that belongs to me.

shots.frame: The night train pulling out of the snowy valley at dawn
shots.motion: Wheels start turning, the train slides out of frame, snow swirls behind
shots.sound: Engine rumble building, wheels on rails

endings.name: Fair Trade
endings.summary: The group exposes Pell, Ines confesses, and the case goes back to the guard. Mara makes her hearing.

shots.frame: Mara stepping off the train onto a sunlit city platform
shots.motion: She exhales and walks out of frame

endings.name: Everybody Gets a Cut
endings.summary: Theo talks the group into splitting what is inside. The train moves, and nobody will ever speak of it.

shots.frame: Three passengers around an open case, faces lit gold
shots.motion: Slow push-in as they look at each other and grin

endings.name: Into the Snow
endings.summary: Pell slips off the train with the case, and the group turns on Ines as the train leaves without him.

shots.frame: Pell walking alone into the snow with the case, train pulling away behind him
shots.motion: Camera holds as he grows smaller

actions: Anyone dies or is seriously hurt

clues.text: Someone's boots are wet with melted snow
A torn ticket stub for a different car
A suitcase in the rack sits oddly high

bridges.narration: Wind rattles the windows. Somewhere down the train, a door bangs shut.

shot.frame: Snow blowing past a dark train window, cabin light reflected in the glass
shot.motion: Snow streaks past, the reflection flickers

bridges.narration: The cabin lights flicker, and for a moment everyone is only a silhouette.

shot.frame: Four silhouettes in a dim train corridor
shot.motion: Cabin lights flicker off and on

bridges.narration: The intercom hums, as if someone is about to speak, then goes quiet again.

shot.frame: Close-up of an old intercom speaker grille with a faint red light
shot.motion: Very slow push-in, the red light pulses once

audience_hooks.phone_prompt: Who do you trust, and what should they do next?
seed_suggestions: Mara should tell everyone what she saw
